Choosing between AirPods 4 and AirPods Pro 3 has mainly come down to fit, features, and price. Apple's camera-equipped AirPods with Visual Intelligence are reportedly in development, but the earliest realistic expectation is 2027, so waiting could mean waiting until the cows come home.

AirPods 4 prioritises comfort and value with options to suit different needs

AirPods 4 uses an open design, making it a strong recommendation if you dislike ear-tip fit. Our AirPods 4 review found the redesigned shape comfortable to wear without sacrificing everyday convenience.

The US$129 model includes the Apple H2 chip, personalised spatial audio, and up to 5 hours of listening time. However, it lacks active noise cancellation (ANC), Transparency mode and wireless charging.

The US$179 model adds functional noise reduction without sealing the ear canal, along with adaptive audio, Transparency mode, and a wireless charging case with a built-in Find My speaker.

An open design will always let in more ambient sound, so noise reduction takes a hit on planes or public transport.

AirPods Pro 3 is the most fully featured option

AirPods Pro 3 is priced at US$249 on Apple's website, though Amazon frequently offers discounts. Their foam-tipped ear tips deliver stronger bass and noticeably better noise reduction. Apple states up to 8 hours with ANC enabled, compared with only 4 hours for AirPods 4 with ANC.

The earbuds can monitor heart rate during workouts and support the Apple Hearing Test, hearing aid and hearing protection features. Our AirPods Pro 3 review found that their workout heart-rate readings broadly matched Apple Watch data.

On the other hand, iOS 27 adds custom EQ to both models, while AirPods Pro 3 gains an edge with its heart-rate sensor and a new charging case.

Should you wait for AirPods with Visual Intelligence?

This week, information about AirPods equipped with Visual Intelligence surfaced from a video hidden inside the macOS Tahoe 26.7 Release Candidate. The clip appears to show someone using camera-equipped AirPods to ask Siri to remember a book with Visual Intelligence, sparking speculation that the product may launch soon.

However, follow-up reports poured cold water on that. Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that AirPods with cameras are still not expected until 2027. The B790 model shown in the video is reportedly a modified version of AirPods Pro 3 that has been cut from Apple's 2026 roadmap. Apple is still working on a newer B798 generation.

Which AirPods should you buy?

If price is your top priority and you don't need noise cancellation, go with the US$129 AirPods 4. If you prefer the open fit, go with the AirPods 4 with ANC.

For everyone else, AirPods Pro 3 is still the best-value choice, especially when Amazon drops them close to the price of the AirPods 4 with ANC. They offer stronger noise reduction, longer battery life, heart-rate monitoring, and Apple's hearing health features.

Today's AirPods pricing

  • AirPods 4 (US$99, was US$129)
  • AirPods 4 with ANC (US$148.99, was US$179)
  • AirPods Pro 3 (US$189.99, was US$249)

Unless Visual Intelligence is absolutely essential to you, waiting makes little sense. Anyone who needs new earbuds now may have to wait well over a year for that unannounced feature, missing out on tangible benefits like stronger noise reduction and longer battery life in the meantime.

Otherwise, just buy based on what you need today. The discounted AirPods available now already meet the practical needs of most buyers, and the future camera-equipped model will likely cost more and retail close to full price at launch.
